text.p: Italian bonds and futures ended a chequered day with around 40 basis points of gains, helped by an overall positive environment for bonds, dealers said.
Dollar weakness against the mark weighed on the lira and dragged BTps down with it.

A European Commission report to Finance Ministers also rapped Italy for "insufficient" spending controls in 1996 and said it had to do much more to bring its 1998 deficit below three percent of gross domestic product.
But Btps were buoyed by what brokers termed as a positive climate for bonds in general.
